newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: BANK OF KOREA INTERVENES TO SUPPORT WON VS DOLLAR.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF KOREA INTERVENES TO SUPPORT WON VS DOLLAR.

text.p: The Bank of Korea intervened in Thursday morning trade, offering to sell dollars at 906 won in three-month forward trading and 916 in six-month forward trading, dealers said.
Dealers said the central bank intervened when the won fell to an intraday low of 895.00 in mid-morning.
"The central bank seems to have drawn a ceiling at the 895 level for the dollar," said a domestic bank dealer.
The won rose again to 894.50 just after the intervention. It opened at 894.50 and touched a high of 894.30.
